format: single-unit End-Cap or In-Line Tropical Smoothie Cafe in a strip retail center (leased, 1,200 to 1,900 sq ft, no drive-thru)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a single-unit Tropical Smoothie Cafe franchise is $275,500 to $770,500. This includes $45,000 that must be paid to franchisor or its affiliate, consisting of a franchise fee of $35,000 and a grand opening marketing contribution of $10,000.

fee.quote: The initial franchise fee for your first Tropical Smoothie Cafe Restaurant is $35,000, payable in full upon execution of the Franchise Agreement.
fee.note: $25,000 for each additional restaurant. Qualified veterans (VetFran): $17,500 for the first and each subsequent Franchised Business. Fees may be discounted in special circumstances; in 2025 initial franchise fees ranged from $1.00 to $35,000. Grand Opening Contribution of at least $10,000 paid to franchisor for first-time franchisees.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 6% of Gross Sales Payable weekly for the prior week's Gross Sales

adFund.quote: National Marketing Fee 5-6% of Gross Sales ... The current National Marketing Fee is 5% of Gross Sales. In the future, we may increase the National Marketing Fee up to 6% of Gross Sales
adFund.note: Currently 5%, up to 6%. A portion of the National Marketing Fee may be allocated to a local advertising cooperative if one is required.

otherRecurring.name: BOH Fees
otherRecurring.amount: One-time implementation fee of $145, and $179 per month subscription fee

otherRecurring.name: Loyalty Platform and Owned Digital Marketing Programs
Gift Card Transaction Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $0.16 per qualified transaction, or $18 per month per cafe, whichever is less

otherRecurring.name: P&L/Financial Data Software Subscription
otherRecurring.amount: Currently $8.00 monthly subscription (currently paid by us)

transferFee.amount: 5% of the total sales price or $10,000, whichever is greater; $2,500 upon transfer of minority interest; or $1,500 upon transfer for convenience of ownership

headline.label: Average annual Net Revenue, franchised traditional Tropical Smoothie Cafe Restaurants open at least one full year

item19.note: Revenues only; no costs or profits. Excludes 33 non-traditional locations, 21 not open at least 357 days in 2025, franchised Restaurants open less than 12 months, and the 1 company-owned Restaurant. 643 (45%) attained or surpassed the average. Range $270,301 to $3,386,973.

special: Technology fees may be raised to cost plus up to 20%; ordering kiosks expected in Q1 2027 at an estimated $10,000-$15,000 upfront and $200-$300 per month (not included in Item 7). Drive-thru adds approximately $40,000 to $60,000. Leasehold improvements in Item 7 are net of an average $44,000 TI Allowance.
issues: Item 7 table low end uses the veterans' fee ($17,500) and the $5,000 grand opening spend for existing franchisees, while the cover says $45,000 is paid to franchisor; toFranchisor fields use the cover figure.
